messages:
mike.t: FYI I discovered a plaintext AWS access key in partner-Y webhook dump we store for debug. Key id ends with Z3Q2. Minimal context here; I'll DM the sample to @anya and drop a redacted line in the channel.

sec-bot: Incident SEC-2026-043 created; evidence archived to s3://redwood-secure/incidents/SEC-2026-043/ and immutable snapshot taken.

mike.t: Redacted sample: `2026-03-23T18:02:11Z debug webhook.receive partner=partner-y file=s3://partner-uploads/y/2026-03-23/dump.log access_key=AKIA************Z3Q2`

anya: Thanks. First priorities: 1) contain (pause partner ingestion), 2) capture usage history (CloudTrail), 3) rotate creds to short-lived role-based tokens, 4) scan repos/artifacts for copies.

ops-oncall: Pausing pipeline now. `kubectl -n ingest scale deploy/partner-y-consumer --replicas=0` -> scaled at 18:05 UTC.

sre-kyle: I'll run CloudTrail lookup and copy events to the evidence bucket: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=AccessKeyId,AttributeValue=AKIA...Z3Q2 --start-time 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z` then `aws s3 cp` results to secure bucket.

anya: Good. After that, revoke the key (make inactive then delete). Mike, DM the raw artifact to me and to legal if there is PII.

mike.t: DM'd the raw snippet to @anya and uploaded the sampled file to the incident folder.

vault-bot: Noted: check Vault mounts for partner-y. Running `vault kv list secret/partners | grep partner-y` and `vault kv get -format=json secret/partners/partner-y` on behalf of @devx-jen.

devx-jen: On the infra side I'd rather move partner integrations off static keys onto a short-lived-sts pattern using an IAM role assumed by our ingestion service. Plan: provision an IAM role for partner-y, map via Vault AWS secrets engine (sts/creds) and update deployment to consume Lease tokens. I'll prepare Terraform changes.

anya: Agreed. Action items: - mike.t: provide artifacts and redacted log (done) - sre-kyle: CloudTrail + evidence (in flight) - ops-oncall: paused (done) - devx-jen: Terraform PR to implement role/sts flow and create rollout plan - vault-bot: check if key exists in any KV mounts and mark secrets for rotation.

vault-bot: Found entry at `secret/partners/partner-y/aws-creds` (ciphertext present). Marking for rotate.

devx-jen: I'll create a short-lived plan: 1) create IAM role `ingest-partner-y-role` with restrictive policy; 2) configure Vault `aws` secrets engine role `partner-y-ingest` to issue STS creds for that role; 3) update deployment to request creds at startup and on lease renew; 4) rollout via canary in staging then prod. I expect PR in ~90m.

anya: Before changing runtime, we need to rotate any persisted material: envelope key rotation if the artifact was wrapped with our KMS key. Check KMS key usage and, if necessary, re-encrypt with a fresh envelope key. @sre-kyle please check CloudKMS/CMK access logs.

sre-kyle: Running quick KMS usage query: `gcloud logging read 'protoPayload.serviceName="cloudkms.googleapis.com" AND protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp' --limit 50` and searching for partner-y references. Will post findings.

mike.t: One more: search CI artifacts and Terraform state for raw key leakage: `git grep -n "AKIA"` across infra and partner repos; also `gsutil ls -r gs://ci-artifacts/* | xargs grep -n "AKIA"` for artifacts. I'll start the scan.

ops-oncall: After revoke and new role is live, I'll coordinate unpause. Keep me posted on rollover readiness.

anya: Owners/timing: containment (0-30m) = ops & sre-kyle; evidence & scope (0-1h) = sre-kyle + mike; rotation plan (1-3h) = devx-jen + vault-bot; rollout & canary (3-6h) = devx-jen + ops-oncall; closure & postmortem (24-72h) = anya.

devx-jen: Creating the IAM role now and will wire Vault role. Will also add a guardrail: deny ability to create long-lived access keys for the ingest partner service account via IAM Condition and org policy.

vault-bot: Marked `secret/partners/partner-y/aws-creds` for destruction after rekey; scheduled rotate TTL on vault lease config to 1h for that role.

anya: Also natty detail: enable higher retention for object-level logs for partner buckets (30d) and ensure CloudTrail log file validation is on for the window we care about. Document chain-of-custody in the incident folder.

sec-bot: Incident status -> containment in progress. Evidence snapshot versioned.

mike.t: Will post updates as we rotate. Thanks all.
